lab.worksheetsHint: Instrument printouts, weighing records and worksheets belong to the revision they were read for. Once the result is handed in they can no longer be changed; an amendment starts a new revision with its own paperwork.

hints.clients: Matched by name or tax ID within the branch: an existing client is updated, a new one is created.
hints.assets: Matched by inventory number within the branch. Accumulated depreciation is taken as given — no back-dated charges are posted.
hints.invoices: Matched by invoice number. New invoices are posted to the ledger, so they appear in the dashboard and ageing at once; invoices already in the system are left untouched.
hints.expenses: Every row becomes a new expense and is posted to the ledger — importing the same file twice doubles the costs.
